notes.note: Reviewed the terminal PTY fixture lifecycle after the final run exposed an afterEach census refusal: three fixture commands requested natural exit but did not await its public ended status. Each now waits for that lifecycle before disposal. Byte/line/Unicode assertions and production fail-closed census ownership checks are unchanged. All 51 session tests passed and the incomplete-page, empty-reset and HTTP sanitizer mutations were recaught with exact green restoration.

Reviewed real-PTY journal-bound proof and process-custody limits. The byte/line cap fixtures explicitly await the natural exit they request before owned cleanup; this avoids treating already-ended custody as successful census ownership. The fix preserves the original payload/cap/Unicode assertions, strict census refusal and shell cleanup behavior. All 51 session tests and three affected HTTP replay fault cycles passed. The optional unrelated 1200-thread EventStore diagnostic timeout is retained as unverified performance evidence, not terminal qualification.

Reviewed scoped session status, bounded replay and cleanup response claims after fixture lifecycle repair. Waiting for requested natural exit is test ownership only; no API, authorization, replay byte limit or cleanup guarantee changes. The repaired fixture preserves byte and Unicode assertions, and incomplete-page, empty-reset and sanitizer faults still fail their named assertions then restore green. Existing prose remains accurate.
